tasks.subject: Add config module reading settings.json
tasks.description: Create src/config.ts: schema + defaults + merge of global ~/.pi/agent/settings.json (via getAgentDir()) and project <cwd>/.pi/settings.json under a "minimalist" key. Must tolerate malformed JSON (log + defaults, never crash). Include migration from the old pi-minimalist.json quiet state. Writes must only touch the "minimalist" key and must refuse if the file contains comments.

tasks.subject: Switch tool claiming from whitelist to blacklist
tasks.description: Default to compacting ALL tools; exclude only names in the configurable blacklist. Replace isCompactTool's whitelist. Add a generic details extractor for unknown tools so they show more than a bare name. Keep renderResult delegating to native renderers so Ctrl+O still shows the third-party card.

tasks.subject: Make truncation width dynamic
tasks.description: Remove the fixed 100-char single-field cap for bash so CompactLine's real viewport-width truncation governs. Keep per-field budgets for COMPOSED details (grep/find pattern vs path) but derive them from available width instead of hardcoding 50. Retain a large sanity cap to avoid colorizing pathological megabyte strings.

tasks.subject: Add gutter, timer, thinking-as-tool, compact-rows toggles
tasks.description: Wire four new config options through row.ts/tool-renderer.ts/thinking.ts: gutter on/off, timer on/off (default on), thinking-as-tool-call (green label + participates in runs like any tool), compact tool rows master switch (off = native rendering).

tasks.subject: Build /minimalist config with SettingsList
tasks.description: Replace /quiet with /minimalist. Use pi-tui's SettingsList via ctx.ui.custom() — same component /settings uses, so arrow keys, hover descriptions and value cycling come for free. Include only: group tool runs, compact tool rows, gutter, thinking as tool call, timer. Persist to settings.json on change.

tasks.subject: Add active-tool and active-thinking fold options
tasks.description:
Two options in /minimalist config, both defaulting to "collapse" (i.e. the option to keep active items expanded defaults to OFF).

1. Active tools: quiet-mode's foldable() currently excludes outcome === "pending", so a running tool never folds into a run. Default becomes: pending rows DO fold. Option keeps them out of runs so you can watch progress.

2. Active thinking: core-patch's updateContent currently forces hidden = false while streaming (neutralizes hideThinkingBlock + the override map). Default becomes: a streaming thinking block stays collapsed to its compact preview. Option restores the force-open behavior.

CONSEQUENCE: item 2 reverses the streaming-expansion behavior the user verified as check 9 earlier today, and its regression test ("forces thinking open while streaming and restores the override after") must be rewritten to assert the new default plus the option. Keep the override-restore guarantee either way — an explicit Ctrl+T expansion must still survive.
